content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fails fallback on both elements).**

- **Affiliate coverage:** the Article II.iii grant runs to Licensee only, and the Additional Restrictions — which apply "notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary" — bar third-party use (p0041) and use by "any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee" (p0045). No path to add Affiliates.
- **Successor transfer:** Article XX(a) automatically terminates the licence on a Change of Control (asset sale, merger, control transfer) unless Licensor consents on broad withholding grounds, and the assignment clause (p0149) expressly routes all Change of Control events there.

**Redline (fallback target, validated ok:true):** grant extended to Affiliates on written notice with the two conflicting use restrictions conformed, and Article XX(a) changed so the licence continues and may transfer to our successor in a merger, acquisition or other Change of Control. Preferred-only items (contractor coverage, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up rights, termination only for uncured material breach) were noted in the rationale rather than pursued.
